content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":20,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight-adjacent"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"fight-adjacent","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const dirs = {up:[0,-1],down:[0,1],left:[-1,0],right:[1,0]}; const d = dirs[p.facing] || [0,1]; const tx = p.x + d[0], ty = p.y + d[1]; const m = ms.find(m => m.x===tx && m.y===ty); if (m) { await b.selectSlot(0); await b.press([{press:['ControllerX'], ms:100}]); } else { const adj = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y)===1); if (adj) { await b.faceAndPress(adj.x, adj.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'swung'})"}]}
